desc: Ideation: select offline block-sweep sqrt decomposition instead of large cross-table precomputation.
Implement input parsing, block-size selection, and query metadata (fa, fb, remainders, sweep groups).
Implement PA sweep over B blocks: maintain cur over A indices, update with each B block using sorted A values and block prefix sums, answer queries grouped by fb via prefix sums of cur.
Implement PB sweep over A blocks: maintain cur over B indices, update with each A block, answer queries grouped by fa for full-A-vs-partial-B via prefix differences.
Implement residual partial/partial sums with sorting + two-pointer, direct small-product fallback, caching, and optional adaptive 2D prefix for heavy repeated block pairs.
Validate on samples and edge cases (block boundaries, N not multiple of S, maximum 64-bit values) and check performance/memory.
